question: How many mantra syllables may be imparted to a śūdra?
premises: Mantras consist of a certain number of syllables.
The recipient in question is a śūdra.
The teacher may impart those syllables accordingly.
inference: One may impart to a śūdra as many syllables of the mantras as are appropriate in this context.
uncertainties: The verse states quantity but the limiting condition may depend on adjacent verses.
plain_english: One may impart to a śūdra as many syllables of the mantras as there are.
